I will keep this wheat plot simple because it is a rented piece and it is only 0.16 hectare. I do mostly what I saw work around me, and when cash is tight I would rather save money than buy seed and fertilizer for such a small plot. I will use my family labor, no irrigation, and I will not spend money on spray unless I see a very bad problem.
